messages:
maya: Heads up — noticed a drop in prefix cache hit-rate on prod since last runtime deploy. Hit from ~72% -> ~45% on short-prefix workloads. Repro in perf-runner. :eyes:

sam: Which deploy? kernel selector change or batching tweak?

maya: Deploy 1894. It's the kernel selector change that prefers `matmul_v2_int8` for seq>512. Also a batching tweak that increases max_batch_size for small seqs.

jordan: Can you paste perf profile / p99 numbers? Also, any change in cache key digest? We had a hash salt added in the last patch.

maya: P99 token latency up ~12%. Quick profiler excerpt (trimmed):
```
profile: tokens_per_sec: 420 -> 370
kv_cache.hit_rate: 0.72 -> 0.45
kernel_selector: matmul_v2_int8 chosen for seq>512
batching: max_batch_size small-seq bumped 16->24
```

kyle: If keying changed, client opt-in header might not match server canonicalization. Are clients sending `x-rw-prefetch` or `x-redwood-cache`?

maya: Our SDK sends header `x-rw-prefetch: enabled` by default. Example: `curl -H 'x-rw-prefetch: enabled' https://api.redwood/internal/generate`

sam: Try forcing `x-rw-prefetch: disabled` and repro. Also check KV warmup TTL — we increased eviction pressure for dedicated nodes this week.

maya: Toggled header locally: with `x-rw-prefetch: disabled` hit-rate recovers to ~70%. So the client opt-in path stops matching server-side canonicalization after the kernel change. Looks like cache key now includes packing info/shape.

jordan: That matches a change I saw: kernel selector started appending `packed_seq` to runtime key to avoid cross-variant reuse. That will break prefix reuse for normal requests.

kyle: Short-term workaround: canonicalize keys by stripping packing-related components. Pseudocode: `key = normalize(key, strip=[\"packed_seq\",\"kernel_variant\"])`

maya: If we change runtime keying, we need gating. Reverting the kernel would restore batching perf but lose long-seq benefit.

sam: Patch keying first — lower blast radius. Also add telemetry: emit `cache_key_components` (sampled) and a metric `cache_mismatch_rate` so we can detect regressions. Instrument SDK to optionally send `x-rw-cache-debug: 1` to sample client-side keys.

maya: :thumbsup: I'll open a PR to normalize keys + add sampled telemetry. I'll include a small reproducer and exact cURL for E2E.

devex: Agree we should add an SDK flag `prefetch_canonical=true` so customers can opt-in to the canonical keying while we roll out.

deploy-bot: Scheduled canary rollback for deploy 1894 at 2026-03-19T15:00Z (if patch not merged by then).

maya: Thanks — will ping once PR is up and add perf-runner job that toggles `x-rw-prefetch` headers and records hit-rate/time series.

sam: Also add an alert on `kv_cache.hit_rate` drop >15% over 10m to catch regressions during kernel/batching rollouts.

maya: On it. I'll link the reproducer and perf graphs here once the PR is open.
